column3: method card: blue legacy / red twin before / green twin now; every cell read while recording
column5: F: Same habits, no server. | M: A user and their admin should find their daily habits unchanged in the browser twin. | F: Blue is real iDempiere, red is the twin before this week, green is the twin now.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT grid.salesOrder legacy=56 now=56 before=7 · grid.verdict PASS 1126/1126 · grid.control wrong on 1024 of 1126
column5: F: First, the grid. | M: Legacy's Sales Order grid shows fifty-six columns. The twin showed seven. | F: Across all one thousand one hundred twenty-six tabs, only one hundred and two matched before. Now every one matches.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT so.rows (only-current rows) · live scroll across the columns
column5: F: Here is the Sales Order grid. | M: It opens on the current orders only, as legacy does, and every column legacy shows is there.
M: Now a business partner. | F: The window opens on Find first, like legacy, because the table is high volume. | M: We search with no criteria and get all twenty-four partners.
F: We change the name, and save. | M: Then once more, and save again. | F: Each save is signed into the browser's own log; nothing else is written. | M: The name now reads Agri-Tech Gardens.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT recinfo rows=2 (Name, old -> new, GardenAdmin, local time)
column5: F: Record Info. | M: Two rows: each change, the old value, the new value, who made it and when. | F: That is the admin's paper trail.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT changelog.rule columns 21782/21782 · control wrong on 55 · changeaudit now=2 storedInMain=0 seedBefore=absent
column5: M: The paper trail. | F: Legacy writes a change log table. The twin works the same rows out of its signed log, with legacy's rule, and stores no second copy. | M: Twenty-one thousand seven hundred eighty-two columns are logged exactly as legacy logs them; before, fifty-five were not.
F: The Change Audit window opens on Find first, like legacy. | M: It used to open on nothing. Now it lists both changes, with the old value and the new value.
M: And by session. | F: Session Audit shows this login, and under it, the same two changes.
F: One more thing: time. | M: The twin used to show these times in UTC, eight hours off here. | F: Now it shows the local clock, as legacy shows the server's.
M: Back on the Home page. | F: Recent Items lists the business partner we just changed. | M: One click opens that exact record.

column3: §ERP_FILM_FACT housekeeping (runtime tables + row counts, none red)
column5: F: And the System Monitor. | M: It counts the log tables kept in the browser. Over five hundred rows, a table turns red with a button to housekeep. | F: Saved parameters are never deleted. Errors stay on the device. Nothing is sent.
